rules: Agent time and token values are excluded because the three-method accounting is incomplete.
No hollow marker or not-recorded placeholder is plotted.
Pure DSH remains stopped_failed with RN=true and NA=false.
Framework Flow Difference compares PyTorch and Jittor, not prediction versus optical-flow ground truth.
Intermediate feature maps are deterministic reductions of the captured tensors, not synthetic data.
